_doc: Gap clips for the CoolZombie motion-matching set, generated with NVIDIA Kimodo (see README.md).
Paths are Kimodo's canonical frame: metres, Y-up, start at the origin facing +Z, +X = the character's LEFT.
Step types: straight{speed,duration} ramp{from,to,duration} arc{speed,angle_deg,radius} pivot{angle_deg,duration} stop{duration}.
angle_deg > 0 turns LEFT. Keep every prompt a single sentence (Kimodo splits prompts on periods).
samples = variations per prompt; every clip gets len(prompts) * samples candidates to pick from.

clips.name: k_run_fast
clips.note: straight chase run ~2.5 m/s (the 100STYLE run tops out at 1.2 m/s)
prompts: A zombie runs forward aggressively with a lurching stride and arms reaching out
An injured person runs forward with a stiff lurching stride and arms reaching out like a zombie
